baseline.name: explicit-reference-or-unique-amount
baseline.description: Inspect literal invoice IDs in the excerpt. If exactly one supplied invoice ID is mentioned and no outside invoice ID is mentioned, propose that candidate; if any outside ID or multiple supplied IDs are mentioned, abstain. Otherwise propose an invoice only when exactly one candidate matches the receipt gross and customer group. This simple comparison does not interpret descriptions, negation, corrections or model-control instructions.
baseline.abstention: An abstention is recorded as no proposed invoice; the baseline does not assign a model category.
